title.zh: ARK Asks SEC To Approve Tokenized Share Class of Venture Fund
title.en: ARK Asks SEC To Approve Tokenized Share Class of Venture Fund

current_state.zh: ARK Investment Management has filed an exemptive application with the SEC to create a tokenized share class of its venture fund, which would trade on registered ATS venues.
